title: Optimal Respiratory Rate Estimation with mmWave Sensing Using PYNQ System-on-Chip Platform
problem: Non-invasive respiratory rate (RR) monitoring using mmWave requires embedded real-time signal processing. Existing approaches may not achieve high accuracy or require complex signal processing.
motivation: Portable embedded deployment of mmWave respiratory monitoring enables continuous health monitoring in IoT and wearable applications without contact or visible sensors.
method: PYNQ platform-based implementation of range and respiration estimation. Signal processing pipeline: (1) Range FFT (RFFT), (2) Phase extraction and unwrapping, (3) FIR filtering, (4) Multiple RR estimation techniques with optimal weighted combination via quadratic cost function.
key_novelty: Optimized multi-technique RR estimation with weighted ensemble on PYNQ embedded platform achieving high accuracy through algorithmic optimization.
contributions: mmWave range and respiration sensing on PYNQ
limitations: Accuracy metrics appear anomalously high (>100% suggesting percentage improvement or error rate notation); abstract only; no comparison with other mmWave RR approaches; limited technical depth on signal processing.
primary_theme: Embedded mmWave signal processing for health monitoring
